name: GCModule

channel.description: number of channels; defaults to x.shape[1]

context.description: optional pre-computed context (B, C, 1, 1); default None

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, channel=None, reduction=4, context=None):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    if channel is None:
        channel = c
    conv1 = nn.Conv2d(channel, 1, kernel_size=1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    transform = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Conv2d(channel, channel // reduction, kernel_size=1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype),
        nn.LayerNorm([channel // reduction, 1, 1]).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype),
        nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        nn.Conv2d(channel // reduction, channel, kernel_size=1).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    )
    if context is None:
        attn = conv1(x)
        b_att, _, h_att, w_att = attn.shape
        attn = attn.view(b_att, 1, h_att * w_att)
        attn = F.softmax(attn, dim=-1)
        x_flat = x.view(b, c, -1)
        context = torch.bmm(x_flat, attn.transpose(1, 2))
        context = context.unsqueeze(-1)
    else:
        context = context.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    y = transform(context)
    out = x + y
    return out
